description: Start a saved Teasa conversation for a story selected by the user. Explicitly supply the selected translation language; this controls the opening and every model reply even when the original story has another source language. No browser authorization or signup required: without OAuth or guestSession, creates a free guest and returns guestSession. Retain it privately; pass it on ALL subsequent tools, retries and pages. Guest access lasts 24 hours. Reuse requestId with guestSession for retries; if cards.nextPage is present, repeat start_story with the same requestId, language and that page. Returns the opening, branchId and branchVersion. No inference is charged for the opening.

guestSession.description: Restricted guest credential returned by start_story. Retain privately and pass on every later call, retry and page. Never put it in a URL.

language.description: Required reading and reply language: en=English, ja=Japanese, ko=Korean, zh=Chinese, es=Spanish. Use the user-selected translation or their requested conversation language, not the story source language. Pass the same language from search_stories to start_story, including retries and pages.

name: start_story
title: Start a Teasa story
